title: Are there key etiquette guidelines I should keep in mind regarding footwear, seating, or sacred spaces?

segments.text: To keep our sacred space pure and welcoming for everyone, please keep the following guidelines in mind: ​Footwear: All footwear must be placed in the designated shoe rack upon entering the main gate. No footwear is permitted inside the sacred grounds or hall. Respecting Sacred Seating (Guru Gaddi): Please do not sit on the sofa inside the main hall or the dedicated sofa outside in the havan area. These are designated as the Guru Gaddi for Parikshit Bhaiya, and we ask everyone to honor and respect these spiritual seats. If you wish to sit on a sofa, comfortable seating is available in the reception area. ​Seating & Practice: Please bring your own pooja mat (aasan) to sit on for sadhana. For elderly guests or those with health conditions who are unable to sit on the ground, chairs are placed separately in the area for your comfort. ​Hygiene & Cleanliness: Keeping our sacred space squeaky clean and pure is everyone’s shared responsibility—not just the duty of the volunteers and sevaks. Please do not litter. Use the dustbins placed around the ashram, or ask a volunteer if you cannot find one. Everyone is expected to participate in maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene. ​Respecting Property & Utilities: Please treat all Ashaeiynn property with care. Be mindful of our shared resources—turn off lights and fans when leaving a room, use water and soaps consciously, and avoid any wastefulness. ​Havan Area: Do not step onto the havan platform—always remain below the platform area. ​Follow Signage: Please read and follow all posted instructions and guidelines displayed around the walls of Ashaeiynn. ​Ask First: If you wish to do something you haven't done before or are unsure about, simply ask a mentor or volunteer first. Above all, maintain respect for the sacredness of the environment and fellow guests.
